findings.message: `setQuantity` accepts any number without checking it, so quantities below 1 or above 99 are not rejected with a `RangeError`. Zero, negative, fractional or NaN values end up in the cart.
When the sku is not in the cart, the function silently returns an unchanged copy of the cart. Callers cannot tell that nothing was updated.

criteria.note: The quantity of a matching item is updated, but no test covers it.
There is no range check and no `RangeError` is thrown.
